title: River Landing
shortDescription: Willow roots hold a little landing above the slow brown river.
longDescription:
River water slips around willow roots with a sound like pages being turned. A flat-bottomed boat rests against the landing, its painter tied in an impressively elaborate knot.
Silver rings spread where insects touch the surface. A flood marker stands beside the post, its bright bands recording days when the river felt much taller.

fixtures.name: Flood Marker
fixtures.examineDescription: Blue, green, and copper bands record old high-water marks. A carved instruction says: 'When the river rises, move the books before the furniture.' Beneath it, someone has added: 'And the biscuits before the books?' A firm line has been drawn through that suggestion.
